scope: Read-only analysis of retained prospective search cohorts. No point search, arithmetic replay, new features requiring arithmetic, candidate generation or automatic follow-up campaign.
freeze_boundary: Frozen after reading published aggregate summaries and record schemas, before fitting models or computing new feature/outcome associations. Historical outcomes are already known: this is retrospective validation, not a new prospective experiment.
primary_cohort: broad-rank-v1: all 2080 frozen slots, including controls and intake failures if any. X948 native-detector analysis is primary; X1092 uses a different detector and is a separate comparison.
secondary_cohorts: The completed r17-60-panel-v1 and retained full-cohort *_r17_results_v1 / *_mw16_results_v1 certificates, including all misses and resource stops. Catalogue matches and repeated equations are retained but flagged. Foundry continuations are read from the last inherited ledger only; they remain a separate adaptively selected/censored cohort. Success-only exports, public controls, commissioning and incomplete search proposals do not supply a prospective denominator.
features: Archive every available frozen score field and source binding. Model inputs are log2 parameter height, log2 denominator, parameter sign, displayed model bits, discriminant bits, score cutoffs 97/257/997, and recorded local-singular-prime count where available. For older cohorts use only comparable recorded selection scores and parameter/model complexity, within cohort. Generic rank and exact generic Gram identifiers/invariants are descriptive strata; parent names are not unseen-family predictors. No final rank, runtime, post-search conductor/class/local profiles or public metadata in model inputs.
events: Merge admissions with the same originating point-call index. Count directions separately from acquiring calls. Reconciliation can discover an old cloud later: source-call ordering is an attribution, not a claim that the larger subgroup was available then. Missing event order/timing remains UNKNOWN.

targets.seed: At least one certified direction beyond the certified starting generic subgroup, within the declared exposure.
targets.further_after_seed: At least two distinct acquiring point calls. Conditional denominator: seeded fibres with recorded calls after the first acquiring call. Also report additional-direction and post-seed-phase endpoints separately.
targets.deep_amplifier: An acquiring call with certified rank already at least 23 from strictly earlier originating calls; a single cloud jumping from below 23 to above it is not sufficient.
targets.four_way_classes: No seed; seed only (one acquiring call); amplifier (two or more acquiring calls); deep amplifier (the deep criterion, taking precedence). Final 18/19 is not automatically a stall. Missing trajectories are UNKNOWN; censoring/exposure status is a separate field. Endpoint-only rank buckets are a separate sensitivity table.

timing: Use retained process-tree CPU and elapsed time separately. When no call-level timestamp exists, report the enclosing batch interval, not an interpolated discovery time. Complete endpoint means the declared policy ended, not that rational points were exhausted.
models: Two fixed models only: ridge logistic regression (sum log loss plus 0.5 times squared standardized coefficients, intercept unpenalized) and a Gini decision tree of depth at most two, minimum leaf max(10, ceil(0.05*n_train)), split candidates at training deciles. No hyperparameter search. Training-only median imputation and standardization.
validation: Leave one fibration out; remove training rows in any held-out exact-equation alias group. Report each fold, not random row splits. Additional leave-one-surface-out results are diagnostic only with two surfaces and detector confounding. Models and baseline training prevalence predict seed, further-gain conditional on exposure, and deep gain separately. Primary test uses broad-rank-v1; r17-60 and earlier uniform fixed-box cohorts are separate sensitivity checks, not pooled exposure.
metrics: Held-out log loss, Brier score, AUROC when both labels occur, and exact 2-by-2 tables for the highest predicted quarter versus remainder (ties broken by fixed row ID). Report counts, risk ratios and Fisher tests; sparse/one-label folds remain explicit. Fisher calculations concern finite conditional label-exchangeability, not a causal or population success-rate theorem. Cross-validation folds share training data: pooled p-values are not independent replication.
decision: No automatic expansion or new search. An actionable enrichment requires at least twofold held-out enrichment with adequate positive support, improvement over the prevalence baseline, and a stable simple rule across a second retained cohort; apply Holm correction across the declared model/fold tests. Otherwise report no validated selection rule and stop this analysis. Do not tune further on a bounded miss.
strategy: Searching harder on the current stalled rank-27/28 fibres is retired as the default rank-32 strategy. No constructor, fixed-word continuation or carrier-bank work is reopened.
